title: mime-tree: walk.rs tests 7 and 8 use code-under-test as oracle, not RFC
description: Tests 1-6 in walk.rs cite RFC 8621 §4.1.4 as oracle. Tests 7 (alternative_mixed_image_gif_goes_to_both_body_lists) and 8 (alternative_mixed_subtree_nullifies_html_body) both cite 'code-path analysis of walk.rs' as their oracle — the code under test. This violates the test integrity rule: tests must have an independent oracle. The behavior being pinned (image/gif appearing in both text_body and html_body) is not explicitly specified by RFC 8621. Cross-validate against Cyrus/Dovecot JMAP implementation or apply the RFC §4.1.4 pseudocode manually.
